avoid: Extended entries (price well above EMA-20 at entry) -- CONFIRMED LOSER, thesis RESOLVED by AMZN (entered Aug 4 at +15.2% above EMA20, stopped -6.57% Aug 17) and META (Jul 15 ~8.5% ext, stopped -8.04% Jul 23). Surviving extended admits are fine now (MSFT +5.81%, QQQ still tightest at -1.50%/2.82% cushion, CRM the +38% exception) but that does not vindicate the entry. Firm rule stands: treat >~6-8% above-EMA extension as size-DOWN or wait-for-pullback; when it co-occurs with a shallow cross, SKIP.

STACKED-FLAG entries (shallow cross + extended above EMA + thin liquidity together) -- SKIP, not size-down: PDBC (0.15% cross + ~6% ext + thin liq, Jul 24) stopped -2.40%. One flag -> size down; two or more stacked -> skip. Applied correctly this week: SLV skipped Aug 28 on TWO flags (+6.9% extended + thin 549k liq).
